title: Tanzkongress 2013 installation
description:
This is the main set for the online score of Deborah Hay's piece »No Time To Fly«. It gives an overview of the areas of material that is available and has links to these.

Formerly this set was called "USING THE SKY – An exploration of Deborah Hay's solo No Time To Fly – Overview". It was the main set running in the installation at Tanzkongress Düsseldorf 2013.
